links.outcome: Omission of safety-critical guidance in crisis and suicidal ideation prompts
links.effect: Omissions occurred in 13.2% of responses, concentrated in crisis and suicidal ideation prompts; hallucinations in 6.5%.
links.quote: Hallucinations occurred in 6.5% of responses and omissions in 13.2%, with omissions concentrated in crisis and suicidal ideation prompts.

links.outcome: Response failures across equivalent prompt variations in context and tone
links.effect: Failures were most consistently associated with context and tone, while user-background indicators showed no systematic differences after balancing.
links.quote: Across regression, element-specific matching, and similarity-matched comparisons, failures were most consistently associated with context and tone, while user-background indicators showed no systematic differences after balancing.

unlisted_practices: Structured prompt construction framework (UTCO) for stress testing LLMs
Evaluating omissions as a primary safety outcome

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM safety risks (hallucinations and omissions) using a synthetic prompt stress-testing framework, but does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
